verdict.rationale: The docs directly cover the core of this story. LiveKit Agents has 'full support for LLM tool use': developers can build a custom tool library, call external APIs, and plug in MCP servers with an MCPToolset. Nothing in the pack shows how the agent avoids dead air while a tool runs, so that half of the story is unsupported. The interruption-handling and turn-detection docs cover a different feature and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented filler speech or latency masking during tool execution, evidence of speaking tool results with low latency, independent hands-on corroboration of mid-conversation tool calls.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can call external APIs and custom functions mid-conversation and speak the result without awkward dead air

citations.quote: LiveKit Agents has full support for LLM tool use. This feature allows you to create a custom library of tools to extend your agent's context
Call external APIs or lookup data for RAG.
Wrap an MCP server in an \`MCPToolset\` and pass it to the agent's \`tools\` parameter
Native support for MCP. Integrate tools provided by MCP servers with one line of code.
